description: This file implements a Zephyr driver for the Ambiq Apollo STIMER hardware timer, providing system clock functionalities such as setting timeouts, handling interrupts, and retrieving elapsed cycles.

methods.name: stimer_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for the STIMER compare match, updates last count, announces ticks.

methods.name: sys_clock_set_timeout
methods.description: Sets the timer timeout based on the number of ticks, configuring the compare register.

methods.name: sys_clock_elapsed
methods.description: Returns the number of elapsed cycles since last kernel tick.

methods.name: sys_clock_cycle_get_32
methods.description: Returns the current 32-bit cycle count from the hardware timer.

methods.name: stimer_init
methods.description: Initializes the STIMER hardware, configures the timer, and sets up interrupts.
